metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds morning prayer at St Helen's, the fair with the fellows, three gingerbread men, and Alse at the stair-foot.

yesterday: The lines were left for the opening. Pope has the bolster, with the feathers thrown in, and Sam has the whistle.
Burbage stood through the wooden king three times. Arthur gave a cut-purse's arrest back in four voices. Kemp bowed out of a ring of two hundred.
Gilbert was behind a stall of points and hat-bands and affected to be a stranger to the players.
The three gingerbread men went to Alse, one of them with gilt. Mistress Ansell said fairings rot the teeth. The back complained from the fourth hour.
Tomorrow at two both houses open. You play Navarre.
